2610.13172.title: RoleWorld: Knowledge Transfer in World Modeling with Functional Role Abstractions
2610.13172.paper_summary: World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld, a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making. In a target world, without the teacher, the actor uses this skill together with its current role assignments and parameter estimates, and actively tests a role instance hypothesis through interaction when its uncertainty affects the current decision. Feedback from each action refines role assignments and estimates parameter values online, with no LLM parameter updates and the transition rules held fixed. Experiments on MARS benchmark show that RoleWorld enables robust generalization across environments with significantly altered object behavior, suggesting that functional role abstractions can serve as an effective component for knowledge transfer in world modeling. Project Page: https://future-item.github.io/RoleWorld.
2610.13172.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型使大型語言模型（LLM）代理能夠預測行動效果並做出明智的決策。<lb/>為了實現泛化，這類世界模型應能有效轉移至具有相似互動結構和潛在動態的新環境。<lb/>近期的方法將世界動態編碼為符號規則或可執行程序，其組合結構原則上支持轉移，但仍然圍繞環境特定對象組織這些知識。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們引入了RoleWorld，一種符號世界建模方法，使用可重用的原型和環境特定的參數值作為功能角色抽象，來表示對象在互動中的行為。<lb/>從互動軌跡中，教師LLM提取角色原型和定義在角色實例上的可執行過渡規則，並提供一項技能，指導行為者LLM在決策中使用角色信息。<lb/>在目標世界中，沒有教師的情況下，行為者使用這項技能，結合當前的角色分配和參數估計，並在不確定性影響當前決策時，通過互動積極測試角色實例假設。<lb/>每次行動的反饋在線上精煉角色分配和參數值的估計，無需LLM參數更新，且過渡規則保持不變。<lb/>在MARS基準上的實驗顯示，RoleWorld能夠在對象行為顯著改變的環境中實現穩健的泛化，這表明功能角色抽象可以作為世界建模中知識轉移的有效組成部分。<lb/>項目頁面：https://future-item.github.io/RoleWorld。
